# Kick

1 endpoint, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 1 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

<!-- BEGIN:GENERATED:ENDPOINTS (auto-generated by generate-docs.ts - AIP-16b) -->

## GET /v1/kick/clip - 1 credit (standard)

Get Kick clip details

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 600s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Post · **Pagination** none

Returns detailed information about a specific Kick clip including the title, view count, duration, category, creator name, channel name, thumbnail URL, and creation timestamp.

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Full URL of the Kick clip · e.g. `https://kick.com/xqc/clips/clip_abc123`

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/kick/clip?url=https://kick.com/xqc/clips/clip_abc123" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
